# Vericeus

> Vericeus is a medical content consultancy. A physician with 25 years of clinical practice (Christian "Chris" Bernardo, MD) and a B2B content strategist with 10+ years of North American agency experience (Janina Bernardo) turn rough drafts, expert notes, and AI-assisted copy into clinically sound, publication-ready healthcare content. Contact: cbernardo@vericeus.com

## Services

- [Services overview](https://vericeus.com/#services): Healthcare content writing, search-informed healthcare content (SEO, AEO, GEO), health-tech marketing copy, and clinical content audits.
- [Team](https://vericeus.com/#team): Credentials of the physician reviewer and the content strategist.
- [FAQ](https://vericeus.com/#faq): How Vericeus works, who it serves, pricing and turnaround.

## Insights (physician-informed health articles)

- [Can Extreme Heat Damage Your Kidneys? Causes, Warning Signs, and Prevention](https://vericeus.com/insights/extreme-heat-kidney-health/): How heat and dehydration can cause acute kidney injury, who is most at risk, warning signs, and prevention. By Chris Bernardo, MD.
- [What China's AI Cooperation Initiative Could Mean for Healthcare in the Philippines](https://vericeus.com/insights/china-ai-cooperation-healthcare-philippines/): Where AI could help Philippine healthcare most (TB and diabetic eye screening, rural chronic care, outbreak surveillance) and the safeguards needed. By Chris Bernardo, MD.
